verdict.rationale: JumpCloud shows several built-in event-triggered automations: conditional access revokes access instantly when a device falls out of compliance or a user leaves a trusted network, and HRIS integration auto-triggers onboarding/offboarding on employee status changes, with Directory Insights logging events for visibility. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose, user-defined rules/workflow engine (e.g., custom 'if event X then action Y' builder) — automation is limited to a fixed set of platform-defined triggers plus API/PowerShell scripting for custom logic. missing for 10: a configurable rules/workflow builder for arbitrary custom triggers, documentation of webhook/event-subscription based automation, and independent confirmation of these automations working in practice.
